parsing_rationale: The document is a technical data model specification. I have extracted the 'Item' entity and its attributes as the primary technical atoms. The relationships and state transitions were mapped to functional requirements and constraints to maintain the graph's integrity. Since the document focuses exclusively on the data model, most of the high-level specification template fields (Goals, Scope, etc.) are missing and have been flagged in structural_gaps.

project_info.brief_explanation: Data model definition for managing saleable items, including entity attributes and state transitions.

sections.title: Data Model: Sales Item Management System
Item
sections.raw_content:
The core entity representing a product for sale.

| Field | Type | Description | Validation |
|-------|------|-------------|------------|
| `id` | String (UUID) | Unique identifier for the item | Required, Unique |
| `name` | String | Display name of the product | Required, Max 100 chars |
| `description` | String | Detailed product information | Optional, Max 500 chars |
| `price` | Number | Sale price of the item | Required, Positive Number |
| `category` | String | Product category (e.g., Electronics, Clothing) | Required |
| `availability` | Boolean | Whether the item is currently in stock | Required, Default: true |
| `imageURL` | String | Path or URL to the product image | Required, Valid URL/Path |

sections.title: Relationships
sections.raw_content: - **Catalog $\rightarrow$ Item**: One-to-Many. The catalog is a collection of `Item` entities.

sections.title: State Transitions
sections.raw_content:
- **Item Creation**: `null` $\rightarrow$ `Item` (via Management Form)
- **Item Update**: `Item (v1)` $\rightarrow$ `Item (v2)` (via Edit Form)
- **Item Deletion**: `Item` $\rightarrow$ `null` (via Delete Action)
- **Availability Toggle**: `available: true` $\leftrightarrow$ `available: false`

elements.content: The core entity representing a product for sale, containing id, name, description, price, category, availability, and imageURL.
Ability to create an Item via a Management Form.
Ability to update an existing Item via an Edit Form.
Ability to delete an Item via a Delete Action.
Ability to toggle the availability status of an item.
Price must be a positive number.
